mentions.name: VRSFML
mentions.description: An opinionated fork of SFML with autobatching that automatically coalesces draw calls for objects using the same RenderStates, turning e.g. 10,000 sprite draws into a single call. It also adds modern OpenGL and first-class Emscripten support, a new audio API supporting multiple simultaneous devices, compile-time API safety, a built-in SFML::ImGui module, SDL3 instead of bespoke platform-dependent code, rendering of 500k+ objects in one draw call, fast compilation, and minimal run-time debug overhead.
mentions.problem: Upstream SFML issues one draw call per object, so drawing many objects requires thousands of separate draw calls.
